scenes.big: Your eyes run in the family
scenes.en: 3 things to tell your eye doctor
scenes.say: Some eye problems run in families. Here are three things to tell your eye doctor.

scenes.en: Risk is higher if a parent, brother or sister has it.
scenes.ta: பெற்றோர், சகோதரருக்கு கிளாக்கோமா இருந்தால் ஆபத்து அதிகம்
scenes.say: Number three. Glaucoma. Your risk is higher if a parent, brother or sister has it. It damages the optic nerve slowly, often with no early signs.

scenes.en: Children of short-sighted parents are more likely to need glasses.
scenes.say: Number two. Short sight. Children with one or both short-sighted parents are more likely to need glasses. So check them early, and send them out to play in daylight.

scenes.en: Family diabetes or high BP? Your retina needs regular checks.
scenes.say: Number one. Diabetes and high blood pressure. If they run in your family, the tiny blood vessels in your retina need regular checks.

scenes.en: Genes are not destiny. Early checks catch changes before you notice them.
scenes.say: Did you know? Genes are not destiny. Early checks can catch changes long before you notice them, and protect your sight.

scenes.en: Ask elders about their eyes. Write it down. Tell your eye doctor.
scenes.say: So ask your elders about their eye problems. Note them down. And tell your eye doctor at every test.

scenes.en: Book an eye test for the whole family.
scenes.say: Book an eye test for the whole family.
